hits.title: Abyss Sphere
hits.text:
The Abyss Sphere is a massive space station and superweapon. Constructed by the autocratic Vastran Dominion, the Abyss Sphere is capable of obliterating entire planets, and serves to enforce the Dominion's reign of terror. It appears as a hundreds of kilometers wide mobile space station that has the shape of a spherical moon or planetoid.

Princess Nira transports the station's schematics to the Freeworld Concord to aid them in destroying the Abyss Sphere. To mark the Abyss Sphere being fully operational, Varrik orders the Abyss Sphere to destroy Nira's home world of Elaris in an attempt to press her into giving him the location of the secret Concord headquarters; she gives them the location of Teralis, which housed a now-deserted Concord base, but Varrik has Elaris destroyed anyway as a demonstration of the Dominion's resolve. Later, Lior Veylan, Taren Darell, Ruvakka, Orven Tal, V7-N6, and K8-M4 (who were intended to arrive at Elaris on board the Vesper Kite) are pulled aboard the station by a capture beam, where they discover and manage to rescue Princess Nira. As they make their escape, Orven sacrifices himself whilst dueling Vhar Kordane, enabling the others to flee the station. Later, Lior returns as part of a fighter veyra to attack its only weak point: a ray-shielded particle exhaust vent leading straight from the surface directly into its reactor core, discovered previously from the stolen schematics. Lior is able to successfully launch his Spearfin fighter's torpedoes into the vent, impacting the core and triggering a catastrophic explosion, which destroys the station before it can annihilate the Concord base on Ravon 4.

Constructed by the autocratic Vastran Dominion, the Abyss Sphere is capable of obliterating entire planets, and serves to enforce the Dominion's reign of terror. hits.text:
The Abyss Sphere is a massive space station and superweapon. Constructed by the autocratic Vastran Dominion, the Abyss Sphere is capable of obliterating entire planets, and serves to enforce the Dominion's reign of terror. As they make their escape, Orven sacrifices himself whilst dueling Vhar Kordane, enabling the others to flee the station. hits.title: Lior Veylan
hits.text:
Raised as a moisture farmer on the desert planet Sovar, Lior joins the Freeworld Concord and becomes a pivotal figure in its struggle against the Vastran Dominion. He trains as a Vaelari Knight under the Vaelari Masters Orven Tal and Ulmor, and eventually confronts his father, the Nerathi Lord Vhar Kordane. hits.title: Istral
hits.text:
Istral is the sixth planet of a remote system of the same name. It is a small, terrestrial planet with three orbiting moons and blanketed entirely by snow and ice. The freezing climate, although habitable, is mostly too cold for intelligent life to develop. Istral is home to only a few species, including the towering, predatory ice ravager, which is the most intelligent creature on the planet, and the gray snow-lizards known as frost runners.

Istral is the home of the Freeworld Concord's secret Frosthold Base, which is partially installed in natural caves formed by giant ice bubbles. The Concord members patrol the planet by riding indigenous frost runners. Lior Veylan and his frost runner are attacked by an ice ravager. Veylan eventually escapes and is rescued by Taren Darell. When one of the Vastran Dominion's probe automata uncovers the base, the Concord members are forced to evacuate. The Dominion arrives and deploys ground forces to destroy the base, but the Concord members battle the Gravity walkers with ground artillery and ice skimmers to stall them and effectively evacuate. This conflict is known as the Battle of Istral.

Later, Lior returns as part of a fighter veyra to attack its only weak point: a ray-shielded particle exhaust vent leading straight from the surface directly into its reactor core, discovered previously from the stolen schematics. Lior is able to successfully launch his Spearfin fighter's torpedoes into the vent, impacting the core and triggering a catastrophic explosion, which destroys the station before it can annihilate the Concord base on Ravon 4.
